study.name: Asael · paired pronunciations · Genesis 1:1–2:3
study.sourceTitle: Vayavinu Bamikra · Parashat Bereshit, first aliyah · Asael
study.coverageStatus: The primary catalog identifies Genesis1:1–2:3 for both performances. Opening the text keeps unchanged UXLC words/accents. Source-edition comparison and word/syllable times remain unreviewed.
study.description: Two original chanted performances by Asael(עשהאל), cataloged with an Ashkenazic melody and separately identified Ashkenazic or Israeli pronunciation. Each retains its own voice, notes, pitch, timing and complete take. Select a pronunciation to compare the original performances.
study.limits: Fixed source performances, separate from all six Kinnor Accent labels and the two Katz research proposals. No complete communal phonology, melody grammar, phoneme bank or independently synthesized singing is established. Timing drafts are specific to one recording; they cannot be transferred between the pair.

The catalog separately names the reader, melody, pronunciation and exact passage. Source Ogg Vorbis payloads match Commons byte counts and SHA1; SHA256 additionally pinned.
